quest.barbarajones.chapter.spine.title: The Craving
quest.barbarajones.chapter.spine.desc: From waking up hungry to four walls and a bowl of Krave.

quest.barbarajones.spine.wake_up.title: The Craving
quest.barbarajones.spine.wake_up.objecti: Wake up. There is a box of something brown in the cupboard and a boy outside who will not stop talking about it. Press K at any time to open this Atlas.
quest.barbarajones.spine.wake_up.lore: Rule #1: Cayden Cobb must not die.
quest.barbarajones.spine.touch_grass.obj: Shear grass or ferns and craft three HANDFULS OF GRASS. Barbara pulls hers straight out of the ground, so you may as well learn how.
quest.barbarajones.spine.touch_grass.lor: She smokes it. Out of the ground. Nobody has ever successfully stopped her.
quest.barbarajones.spine.the_knife.title: Mise en Place
quest.barbarajones.spine.the_knife.objec: Craft a GRASS KNIFE, then dice grass with it twice. Fair warning: the knife goes into the recipe and does not come back. Craft a second one, or take the spare this quest hands you.
quest.barbarajones.spine.the_knife.lore: The old quest book asked you to be holding the knife AND the diced grass at the same time. It never noticed the recipe eats the knife. That quest could not be completed. Ever.
quest.barbarajones.spine.the_cereal.obje: Craft 4x KRAVE CEREAL - two wheat, one sugar, one cocoa bean - and pour a KRAVE MILK.
quest.barbarajones.spine.the_cereal.lore: Chocolate on the outside. Chocolate on the inside. There is no third layer.
quest.barbarajones.spine.first_bowl.obje: Craft a CEREAL BOWL: an empty bowl, Krave, and Krave Milk. The compass this hands you always points at Cayden.
quest.barbarajones.spine.first_bowl.lore: You will want to know where he is at all times. See Rule #1.
quest.barbarajones.spine.first_house.obj: Build somewhere to live: lay 3 SHAG CARPET and set down a STASH BOX.
quest.barbarajones.spine.first_house.lor: It is not much. It has a carpet. It counts.
quest.barbarajones.village.roof.title: A Roof Over Rule #1
quest.barbarajones.village.roof.objectiv: Get Cayden a real room - enclosed, lit, and tall enough to stand up in - until the village reads tier 2. The HOUSING QUERY tool tells you exactly what is wrong with it.
quest.barbarajones.village.roof.lore: Rule #1 is considerably easier to keep indoors.
quest.barbarajones.village.feed.title: Provider
quest.barbarajones.village.feed.objectiv: Feed Cayden 10 times. Krave, nuggets, Pibb - he is not fussy, he is just permanently hungry.
quest.barbarajones.village.feed.lore: He gets wider. That is a feature.
quest.barbarajones.village.workshop.obje: Put up 8 WOOD PANELING and push the village to tier 3.
quest.barbarajones.village.workshop.lore: Dark oak and brown dye. Very 1974.
quest.barbarajones.village.living_room.o: Set down a TELEVISION and a RECLINER, and push the village to tier 4.
quest.barbarajones.village.living_room.l: Cayden will find the recliner within about four seconds.
quest.barbarajones.village.the_stash.obj: Place a KRAFTING BENCH and push the village to tier 5. Somebody has been keeping five hundred dollars behind the panelling.
quest.barbarajones.village.the_stash.lor: Do not ask whose money it was. You are going to spend it anyway.
quest.barbarajones.kosmos.the_door.title: The Door
quest.barbarajones.kosmos.the_door.objec: Craft and place a KRAVE DOOR - obsidian, amethyst, and a genuinely terrible idea.
quest.barbarajones.kosmos.the_door.lore: It hums. Doors are not supposed to hum.
quest.barbarajones.kosmos.arrival.title: Arrival
quest.barbarajones.kosmos.arrival.object: Step through into the KRAVE KOSMOS.
quest.barbarajones.kosmos.arrival.lore: It is warm. That is the worst part.
quest.barbarajones.kosmos.kravelings.obj: Kill 8 KRAVE MINIONS. They only exist on the far side of the door, so this is not something you can grind out at home.
quest.barbarajones.kosmos.kravelings.lor: Little ones. Teeth all the way round.
quest.barbarajones.kosmos.deep_krave.obj: Grind 24 KRAVE DUST out of cereal and reach Krave level 8.
quest.barbarajones.kosmos.deep_krave.lor: Every bowl you have ever eaten, powdered.
quest.barbarajones.kosmos.kosmonaut.obje: Both halves of the Kosmos handled. Nothing left to do here but take the schematic and go home.
quest.barbarajones.kosmos.kosmonaut.lore: Nobody is impressed. You are a little impressed.
quest.barbarajones.bosses.the_monster.ob: Craft a KRAVE BOX, right-click it on open ground, and put the KRAVE MONSTER down. Barbara and Cayden fight at your side.
quest.barbarajones.bosses.the_monster.lo: He teleports between blinks. Hit him on the way back.
quest.barbarajones.bosses.the_deal.title: What $500 Buys
quest.barbarajones.bosses.the_deal.objec: Hand over MOM'S $500. Yes, all of it. Yes, you will regret it.
quest.barbarajones.bosses.the_deal.lore: The Atlas takes the money out of your bag when you press the button, and only then. It will never quietly require you to be carrying something.
quest.barbarajones.bosses.mom.title: Mom Cobb
quest.barbarajones.bosses.mom.objective: She heard about the money. Defeat MOM COBB.
quest.barbarajones.bosses.mom.lore: The belt is memorabilia. She has another one.
quest.barbarajones.bosses.the_plug.title: Got That Mothafucker
quest.barbarajones.bosses.the_plug.objec: The Plug scammed you and then shot at you from three hundred blocks. Defeat THE PLUG.
quest.barbarajones.bosses.the_manager.ob: Somebody has to answer for the off-brand cereal. Defeat THE MANAGER.
quest.barbarajones.bosses.the_manager.lo: He has been employee of the month eleven times running. Unopposed.
quest.barbarajones.bosses.peace.title: Peace at Last
quest.barbarajones.bosses.peace.objectiv: Every boss down, the village standing, and the kid still breathing. Rule #1 held.
quest.barbarajones.bosses.peace.lore: The death stages, of course, remain. Forever.
barbarajones.build.preview.on: Schematic unfolded. Point at the ground, R to turn, sneak + right-click to build.
barbarajones.build.tooltip.blank: Blank - no building drawn on it yet.
barbarajones.build.fail.unknown: This schematic does not name a building anyone has drawn.
barbarajones.build.fail.no_target: Point at the ground you want to build on.
barbarajones.build.fail.no_ground: There is no solid ground under part of that footprint.
barbarajones.build.fail.uneven: The ground here is off by %s blocks and this building can only level %s. Find somewhere flatter.
barbarajones.build.fail.strict: This building needs perfectly flat ground and this is not it.
barbarajones.build.fail.blocked: %s at %s, %s, %s is in the way. Buildings will not overwrite what you built.
barbarajones.build.fail.lava: There is lava in that footprint. Absolutely not.
barbarajones.build.fail.world_height: That building will not fit between bedrock and the sky here.
barbarajones.build.fail.too_big: That building is wider than the %s block placement limit.
barbarajones.build.fail.busy: Something is already going up on that spot. Wait for it to finish.
barbarajones.build.core.window: %s - break this stone to undo it (%s seconds left)

barbarajones.build.undo.too_late: Too late to undo this one - it has settled.
barbarajones.build.undo.not_yours: Somebody else raised this building. Only they can pull it down.
barbarajones.build.undo.no_snapshot: No record of what was here before, so this cannot be undone.
barbarajones.build.undo.stale: The block list changed since this was built, so undoing it is no longer safe.
